message: Preregistered a same-data, same-model replacement that encodes the frozen 16.6M tokenizer once per 160-frame record and trains dynamics from latent ArrayRecords. No offline latent shards or CR-DYN-0011 optimizer updates exist yet.
Frozen the tested offline-latent implementation before remote execution. The exact source passed 166 tests, experiment-ledger validation, all CoinRun shell syntax checks and git diff checks.

An external DSW stop interrupted the first encoding attempt, after which the same instance resumed and atomically published all 4,096 train latent records. The generic training recorder then rejected the successful preprocessing child because it correctly did not emit training runtime-identity/run-state files. No dynamics update started. A precise regression was red, and the protocol-neutral fix removes that inappropriate wrapper while retaining the complete train latent dataset for full audit.
evidence: error:recorded command succeeded without runtime-identity.json and run-state.json

message: Frozen the tested zero-update preprocessing-runner repair before recovery. The repair only removes the generic training recorder around immutable tokenization; the latent protocol, data, model and 200k dynamics schedule are unchanged.

Offline train/eval tokenization and full pair audits completed. All 4,096 train and 512 held-out records preserve exact actions, rewards, terminals, record order and source raw-tree identities. The clean detached recovery source then started the unchanged 3.93M, 200,000-update dynamics protocol from scratch; no CR-DYN-0010 dynamics checkpoint was reused.

The existing DSW shutdown timer stopped the A10 after the run had emitted its 60k validation and metrics through completed update 62,601. The same instance later returned to Running, but pipeline PID 1794 was dead and the GPU was idle. The experiment is blocked rather than failed; no monitor restarted training.
